changes.title: Read Tim Cook’s final message to Apple staff as CEO
changes.summary: Steve Jobs' successor carried the torch of the iPhone and built Apple into a global powerhouse with few rivals. Since becoming CEO in 2011, Tim Cook has led the company to become one of the most dominant forces in the daily lives of billions of people. Today is his last day as CEO. changes.title: Phil Schiller is leaving his biggest jobs at Apple
